info.title: Bidora shared-login portal routing
info.description: Canonical current-account routing contract. Account type selects an allowlisted portal destination but never grants tenant or platform authority. TP-F01 requires at least one current active Tenderpreneur membership before returning the Tenderpreneur destination.

x-approval.evidence: requesting user explicitly approved the BID-API-010 portal-routing contract and requested BID-AUTH-003 account-type implementation
scope: self-selection of Tenderpreneur or Procurement only

get.summary: Resolve the current account's portal destination
get.description: Requires a current browser session and exact approved HTTPS Origin. Accepts no body or query. The server returns one allowlisted destination from the immutable Phase 1 account type, current Tenderpreneur membership presence or current platform-assurance facts. This response is navigation metadata only: it is not a tenant selector, membership, capability grant or database locator.

200.description: Current account type and safe portal destination.

post.summary: Select a Tenderpreneur or Procurement account type once
post.description: Requires the verified current browser account, exact approved HTTPS Origin, session-bound CSRF and an idempotency key. The strict application/json body is limited to 4 KiB and rejects duplicate or unknown members. Only an UNASSIGNED account may self-select TENDERPRENEUR or PROCUREMENT. PLATFORM_ADMIN is invitation/bootstrap only. Selection creates no tenant, membership, capability, subscription or database routing authority and cannot be changed through this endpoint. The account-type update, idempotency result, minimal audit and outbox fact commit atomically; the existing session remains valid because this selection grants no authority.

204.description: Account type selected, or a matching idempotent replay completed. No body.

platform_context_generation.description: Non-null only for an eligible PLATFORM_ADMIN account. It is a stale-context selector for platform APIs, never authority.

capabilities.description: Current explicit Platform Administration capabilities for an eligible PLATFORM_ADMIN account; empty for other account types and for primary-only rotated administrator sessions awaiting reauthentication. Every platform operation still rechecks current authority.

Failure.description: Safe failure without identity, membership, platform-assignment, secret or database details.

x-invariants: UNASSIGNED returns portal null and required action SELECT_ACCOUNT_TYPE
TENDERPRENEUR resolves only to /tenderpreneur and only while at least one current ACTIVE membership in an ACTIVE Tenderpreneur tenant exists for the verified enabled identity
TENDERPRENEUR without an eligible membership returns no portal and required action ESTABLISH_TENDERPRENEUR_MEMBERSHIP; this action itself creates no tenant or authority
PLATFORM_ADMIN with a primary-only rotated session returns portal null, no capabilities or context generation, and COMPLETE_PLATFORM_STEP_UP; no platform eligibility or authority is implied
PLATFORM_ADMIN without a current active platform assignment is denied once administrator verification is complete, never routed
PLATFORM_ADMIN with missing MFA or insufficient assurance returns portal null and the applicable required action
PLATFORM_ADMIN with a current assignment, enrolled MFA and AAL2 resolves only to /platform
account type and platform_context_generation never grant tenant membership, capability, active context or database routing
an eligible PLATFORM_ADMIN response includes the current platform_context_generation used as a stale-context selector by platform APIs
a caller cannot self-select PLATFORM_ADMIN or change an assigned account type
inconsistent or unknown persisted state fails closed rather than choosing a default portal
